what: EX01 P0 stage-2: ccx load-scaling invariance + Abaqus N_cr comparison
status: diagnostic; NOT a final cause conclusion (EX01 10.2 still stands)

equations.N_cr: N_cr = lambda * P_ref  (linear buckling; load multiplier times reference pressure)

abaqus.note: N_cr is compared across DIFFERENT P_ref on purpose: for linear buckling N_cr should be P_ref-invariant. Abaqus-side 3-tier invariance is still unverified (external bat pending).

confirmed_facts: F-s2-1: p050 and p020 (no lambda<1, lambda1 = 1.405239 / 3.513126) give N_cr1 = 0.07026195 / 0.07026252 MPa, rel = 8.11e-06 (0.00081%) -- load-scaling invariance HOLDS in the safe lambda region.
F-s2-2: p100 (3 eigenvalues below 1.0, whole 6-mode spectrum inside [0.9495, 1.0419]) gives N_cr1 = 0.09495004 MPa, 29.89% above the safe mean -- the sigma=1.0 neighbourhood tier is NOT invariant.
F-s2-3: lambda scales as 1/P_ref between safe tiers: 1.405239 x 0.05 = 0.07026195 and 3.513126 x 0.02 = 0.07026252.
F-s2-4: if the safe N_cr is physical, ccx at P_ref=0.1 should have lambda1 = 0.702622; that value is ABSENT in the 6-mode p100 spectrum -- 6 modes still missed the true lowest root near sigma=1.0.
F-s2-5: Abaqus .msg full precision lambda1 = 0.687155 => N_cr = 0.0687155 MPa; vs ccx safe mean 0.07026224 MPa => rel = 2.2259%.
F-s2-6: per-mode N_cr rel(p050,p020) for modes 1..6 = [8e-06, 1e-06, 0.0, 0.000474, 0.003951, 0.056229] -- low modes stable, high modes drift => supports judging lambda1 ONLY (Q3).
still_open: Abaqus-side 3-tier load scaling (external bat not yet run): its own N_cr invariance unverified.
Mode-shape MAC pairing (P0-3) still absent; the ~2% N_cr gap cannot be attributed to any formulation yet.
Mesh convergence / analytical shell buckling anchor absent (U2, U3).
Physical correctness of the absolute N_cr is NOT established; diagnostic only.
EX01 10.2 'no final cause conclusion at this stage' REMAINS VALID.
